dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible with sharp contrast gradients between dark exterior pelage and light-intensity ring perimeters. The most prominent annulus in the lower-center exhibits a closed circular geometry, while secondary structures in the mid-right and upper-left regions show more irregular, semi-closed 'C' geometries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters is localized on the lower-left ventral-lateral appendage. A lower density of scattered, individual high-intensity blobs without internal gradients is observed along the upper dorsal-most horizontal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the primary lower-center annulus and two upper-lateral annuli form an irregular obtuse triangle. The clusters of high-intensity blobs on the lower-left region form a dense, elongated polygon relative to the central annulus.

other_distinctive_markers: The upper-central dorsal region exhibits an interconnected, chain-like series of light-intensity rings forming a continuous topological sequence.
